$comment: Shared conformance vectors for the form-rules engine; see form-rules.md. Compared fields: expected.* only (messages are not compared). errors are compared as a set of {fieldKey, code}.

vectors.name: text-required-missing
vectors.description: Static required TEXT with no value yields REQUIRED.

vectors.name: text-required-whitespace-only
vectors.description: A string made only of ASCII whitespace (space, tab, LF, CR) is empty, so required fails.

vectors.name: text-value-kept-untrimmed
vectors.description: Non-empty text is persisted exactly as submitted (no trimming).

vectors.name: text-optional-empty-omitted
vectors.description: Optional TEXT submitted as empty string: no error and omitted from normalized values.

vectors.name: text-wrong-json-type
vectors.description: TEXT given a JSON number: INVALID_TYPE (no coercion).

vectors.name: text-too-long
vectors.description: maxLength counts UTF-16 code units; 6 > 5 yields TOO_LONG.

vectors.name: text-max-length-boundary-ok
vectors.description: Exactly maxLength characters is allowed.

vectors.name: text-pattern-mismatch
vectors.description: pattern is an unanchored ECMAScript regex search; "ABC-12" does not match ^[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}$.

vectors.name: text-pattern-match
vectors.description: Matching value passes pattern.

vectors.name: text-eq-is-ascii-case-insensitive
vectors.description: eq on TEXT folds ASCII case only: "ACME" equals literal "acme", so the dependent field is shown.

vectors.name: text-eq-non-ascii-is-exact
vectors.description: Non-ASCII letters are NOT case folded: "É" does not equal "é", so the dependent field stays hidden and its value is dropped.

vectors.name: url-valid-and-invalid
vectors.description: URL must be an absolute http/https URL; the second field fails with INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: number-above-max
vectors.description: NUMBER above validation.max yields OUT_OF_RANGE.

vectors.name: number-at-bounds-ok
vectors.description: Bounds are inclusive.

vectors.name: number-string-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: No coercion: the JSON string "12" is INVALID_TYPE for NUMBER.

vectors.name: number-zero-satisfies-required
vectors.description: 0 is a value, not empty: required is satisfied and 0 is persisted.

vectors.name: number-required-when-gt
vectors.description: requiredWhen gt: volume 1500 > 1000 makes justification required; 1000 would not.

vectors.name: number-boundary-gt-not-required
vectors.description: gt is strict: volume 1000 does not make justification required.

vectors.name: number-invalid-type-reads-as-null-in-rules
vectors.description: A type-invalid value reads as null in rules: neq on null is true, so the dependent field is shown (INVALID_TYPE still reported).

vectors.name: checkbox-false-satisfies-required
vectors.description: false is an answer: a required CHECKBOX with false passes; only null/absent fails.

vectors.name: checkbox-absent-required
vectors.description: Required CHECKBOX with no value: REQUIRED.

vectors.name: checkbox-string-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: No coercion: the JSON string "true" is INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: checkbox-true-shows-and-requires
vectors.description: requires_ocr=true shows ocr_language and makes it conditionally required; it is missing, so REQUIRED.

vectors.name: checkbox-false-hides-and-drops-value
vectors.description: requires_ocr=false hides ocr_language; the submitted value is dropped silently (no error, not persisted).

vectors.name: checkbox-unanswered-isfalse-is-false
vectors.description: isTrue and isFalse are both false on an unanswered checkbox; not(isTrue) is true.

vectors.name: select-valid-option
vectors.description: SELECT with a declared option key is accepted.

vectors.name: select-unknown-option
vectors.description: SELECT value not among declared options: OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED.

vectors.name: select-option-keys-case-sensitive
vectors.description: Option keys are compared exactly: "FAST" is not "fast".

vectors.name: select-number-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: SELECT value must be a string.

vectors.name: radio-eq-show-when
vectors.description: RADIO eq (exact, case-sensitive) controls visibility.

vectors.name: select-in-and-notin
vectors.description: in / notIn on a SELECT: "full" is in [full, deep] and not in [fast].

vectors.name: select-neq-on-empty-is-true
vectors.description: Comparisons against null are false except neq / notIn / isEmpty: neq on an unanswered SELECT shows the field.

vectors.name: option-availability-filters-set
vectors.description: Option availableWhen filters the offered set: country=us leaves [ny, any].

vectors.name: option-unavailable-selected-rejected
vectors.description: Selecting an option whose availableWhen is false yields OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED even though it is declared.

vectors.name: option-availability-reads-null-when-source-empty
vectors.description: availableWhen reading an empty field sees null: eq is false, so only unconditional options remain.

vectors.name: multiselect-valid-keeps-order
vectors.description: Valid selection is persisted in submitted order.

vectors.name: multiselect-one-bad-key
vectors.description: One undeclared key yields exactly one OPTION_NOT_ALLOWED for the field.

vectors.name: multiselect-duplicate-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: Duplicate keys in a MULTISELECT array: INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: multiselect-empty-array-required
vectors.description: An empty array is empty: a required MULTISELECT fails with REQUIRED.

vectors.name: multiselect-contains-shows-field
vectors.description: contains tests membership of the selection; "pdf" is selected so pdf_options is shown, tiff_options is hidden.

vectors.name: multiselect-not-contains-on-empty
vectors.description: contains on an empty MULTISELECT is false, so not(contains) is true.

vectors.name: date-valid-in-range
vectors.description: Valid date inside [min, max].

vectors.name: date-before-min
vectors.description: Date before min: OUT_OF_RANGE.

vectors.name: date-impossible-calendar-day
vectors.description: 2026-02-30 is not a real date: INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: date-wrong-format
vectors.description: Only yyyy-MM-dd is accepted: 2026-6-30 and "06/30/2026" are INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: date-gte-rule-ordinal
vectors.description: Date rules compare chronologically (ordinal on yyyy-MM-dd): 2026-03-01 >= 2026-01-01 shows rush_reason, < 2026-02-01 would not.

vectors.name: datetime-format
vectors.description: DATETIME must be ISO-8601 UTC with Z: the offset form is INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: user-ref-integer-only
vectors.description: USER_REF / ASSET_REF are positive integers; existence is a server concern outside these vectors.

vectors.name: nested-and-or-true-via-second-branch
vectors.description: a AND (b=x OR c): a=true, b=y, c=true => shown and required.

vectors.name: nested-and-or-false
vectors.description: a AND (b=x OR c): a=true, b=y, c=false => hidden; submitted value dropped.

vectors.name: nested-and-or-outer-false
vectors.description: a=false short-circuits the AND even if b=x.

vectors.name: nested-depth-three-ok
vectors.description: or(and(a,b),c) has depth 3 (leaf=1, and=2, or=3), the maximum allowed, so the definition is valid.

vectors.name: not-operator
vectors.description: not inverts: not(eq(b, x)) with b=y is true.

vectors.name: hidden-required-is-not-required
vectors.description: A statically required field that is hidden is not required and produces no error.

vectors.name: hidden-value-reads-as-null-for-dependents
vectors.description: A hidden field reads as null: b is hidden (a=false) so c, which needs b=x, is hidden too even though b=x was submitted.

vectors.name: hidden-invalid-value-is-silently-dropped
vectors.description: Hidden fields are not validated: an invalid-typed value for a hidden field is dropped without error.

vectors.name: section-hidden-hides-members
vectors.description: Fields in a hidden section inherit hidden: adv_note (required) is hidden, not required, and dropped.

vectors.name: section-visible-shows-members
vectors.description: With the section visible, adv_note (required) is enforced.

vectors.name: draft-mode-skips-required-only
vectors.description: mode=draft: REQUIRED is not enforced but type errors still are; required map is unchanged.

vectors.name: unknown-key-submitted
vectors.description: A submitted key that is not a field (or is a non-input SECTION_HEADING / HELP_TEXT) yields UNKNOWN_FIELD.

vectors.name: def-circular-two-fields
vectors.description: a shows when b is true, b shows when a is true: CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY.

vectors.name: def-circular-three-mixed-rule-kinds
vectors.description: Cycle across showWhen, requiredWhen and an option availableWhen: a -> b -> c -> a.

vectors.name: def-circular-through-section
vectors.description: The heading depends on a member of its own section: member -> heading -> member.

vectors.name: def-self-reference-show-when
vectors.description: A field may not reference itself.

vectors.name: def-self-reference-option-rule
vectors.description: An option rule may not reference its own field.

vectors.name: def-unknown-field-reference
vectors.description: Rule references a field that is not in the form.

vectors.name: def-reference-to-heading
vectors.description: Rules may not reference SECTION_HEADING or HELP_TEXT fields.

vectors.name: def-rule-too-deep
vectors.description: and > or > not > leaf has depth 4 (> 3): RULE_TOO_DEEP.

vectors.name: def-operator-type-mismatch-ordering-on-select
vectors.description: Ordering operators are not allowed on SELECT.

vectors.name: def-operator-type-mismatch-istrue-on-text
vectors.description: isTrue only applies to CHECKBOX.

vectors.name: def-literal-type-mismatch
vectors.description: NUMBER compared with a string literal.

vectors.name: def-unknown-option-reference
vectors.description: Rule literal is not a declared option key of the referenced SELECT.

vectors.name: def-duplicate-field-key
vectors.description: Two fields share a key.

vectors.name: def-duplicate-option-key
vectors.description: Two options of one field share a key.

vectors.name: def-rule-fails-json-schema
vectors.description: Unknown operator "xor" violates the rule JSON schema.

vectors.name: def-invalid-section
vectors.description: section must name an existing SECTION_HEADING.

vectors.name: null-show-when-is-absent
vectors.description: showWhen null means absent: the field is always shown.

vectors.name: null-required-when-is-absent
vectors.description: requiredWhen null means absent: only the static flag applies.

vectors.name: null-available-when-is-absent
vectors.description: Option availableWhen null means always available.

vectors.name: null-optional-members-are-absent
vectors.description: null label, required, section, options, validation members and validation itself behave as if omitted.

vectors.name: null-value-for-unknown-key-is-unknown-field
vectors.description: A submitted key that is not an input field is UNKNOWN_FIELD even when its value is null.

vectors.name: unknown-key-is-case-sensitive
vectors.description: Submitted keys match field keys exactly: "Custodian" is unknown while "custodian" is a field.

vectors.name: def-rule-string-is-schema-violation
vectors.description: A rule that is a JSON string (not an object and not null) is SCHEMA_VIOLATION.

vectors.name: def-rule-array-is-schema-violation
vectors.description: A rule that is a JSON array is SCHEMA_VIOLATION.

vectors.name: def-field-key-uppercase
vectors.description: Field keys must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$: uppercase is INVALID_FIELD_KEY.

vectors.name: def-field-key-leading-digit
vectors.description: A field key starting with a digit is INVALID_FIELD_KEY.

vectors.name: def-field-key-hyphen
vectors.description: A field key containing a hyphen is INVALID_FIELD_KEY.

vectors.name: def-field-key-too-long
vectors.description: A 65-character field key is INVALID_FIELD_KEY.

vectors.name: def-option-key-leading-dash
vectors.description: Option keys must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$: a leading dash is INVALID_OPTION_KEY.

vectors.name: def-option-key-with-space
vectors.description: An option key containing a space is INVALID_OPTION_KEY.

vectors.name: def-unknown-control
vectors.description: A control that is not in the catalog is UNKNOWN_CONTROL.

vectors.name: def-unknown-control-is-case-sensitive
vectors.description: Control names are exact: "text" is UNKNOWN_CONTROL.

vectors.name: def-select-without-options
vectors.description: SELECT without options is NO_OPTIONS.

vectors.name: def-radio-empty-options-array
vectors.description: RADIO with an empty options array is NO_OPTIONS.

vectors.name: def-multiselect-null-options
vectors.description: MULTISELECT with options null is NO_OPTIONS.

vectors.name: options-on-non-option-control-are-ignored
vectors.description: Options (even invalid or duplicated) on a control that has no options are ignored entirely.

vectors.name: def-duplicate-field-key-reported-alone
vectors.description: Duplicate field keys short-circuit every other check, including key shape and references.

vectors.name: def-multiple-codes-reported-together
vectors.description: Apart from duplicate field keys, all checks run and every distinct code is reported.

vectors.name: def-self-reference-to-heading-is-invalid-reference-target
vectors.description: Check order for a leaf is unknown field, non-input target, self reference: a heading referencing itself is INVALID_REFERENCE_TARGET.

vectors.name: def-rule-date-literal-impossible-day
vectors.description: A DATE rule literal must be a real calendar date: 2026-02-30 is LITERAL_TYPE_MISMATCH.

vectors.name: def-rule-literal-beyond-double-range
vectors.description: A rule literal that is not a finite double (1e999) fails the rule schema: SCHEMA_VIOLATION.

vectors.name: def-number-in-mixed-literals
vectors.description: Every literal of in/notIn must have the control literal type: [1,"2"] on NUMBER is LITERAL_TYPE_MISMATCH.

vectors.name: def-ref-literal-above-safe-integer
vectors.description: A reference-id rule literal above 2^53-1 is LITERAL_TYPE_MISMATCH.

vectors.name: def-section-cycle-between-headings
vectors.description: Two headings that belong to each other form a cycle: CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY.

vectors.name: heading-may-belong-to-heading
vectors.description: Nested sections: a heading inside a hidden heading is hidden, and so are its members.

vectors.name: help-text-required-flag-is-ignored
vectors.description: required on a non-input control is ignored: the required map is false and nothing is demanded.

vectors.name: def-number-min-is-string
vectors.description: NUMBER bounds must be JSON numbers: min "5" is INVALID_VALIDATION.

vectors.name: def-date-min-is-number
vectors.description: DATE bounds must be yyyy-MM-dd strings: min 3 is INVALID_VALIDATION.

vectors.name: def-date-max-impossible-day
vectors.description: A DATE bound must be a real calendar date: 2026-02-30 is INVALID_VALIDATION.

vectors.name: def-number-min-greater-than-max
vectors.description: min greater than max is INVALID_VALIDATION.

vectors.name: def-date-min-after-max
vectors.description: DATE min after max is INVALID_VALIDATION.

vectors.name: def-max-length-zero
vectors.description: maxLength must be an integer from 1 to 2147483647: 0 is INVALID_VALIDATION.

vectors.name: def-max-length-fractional
vectors.description: A fractional maxLength is INVALID_VALIDATION.

vectors.name: def-pattern-message-too-long
vectors.description: patternMessage longer than 200 characters is INVALID_VALIDATION.

vectors.name: def-pattern-message-empty
vectors.description: An empty patternMessage is INVALID_VALIDATION.

vectors.name: validation-min-equal-max-ok
vectors.description: min equal to max is allowed and accepts exactly that value.

vectors.name: validation-members-ignored-on-other-controls
vectors.description: Validation members that do not apply to the control are ignored, whatever their value.

vectors.name: validation-max-length-integral-float
vectors.description: maxLength 5.0 is the integer 5 (a JSON number with integral value).

vectors.name: def-pattern-lookahead
vectors.description: Lookahead is outside the portable subset: INVALID_PATTERN.

vectors.name: def-pattern-lookbehind
vectors.description: Lookbehind is outside the portable subset.

vectors.name: def-pattern-named-group
vectors.description: Named groups are outside the portable subset.

vectors.name: def-pattern-backreference
vectors.description: Backreferences are outside the portable subset.

vectors.name: def-pattern-whitespace-class
vectors.description: \s differs between engines and is not allowed; use [ \t] instead.

vectors.name: def-pattern-unicode-property
vectors.description: \p{..} is not allowed.

vectors.name: def-pattern-unicode-escape
vectors.description: \uXXXX is not allowed; write the character itself.

vectors.name: def-pattern-inline-flags
vectors.description: Inline flags such as (?i) are not allowed.

vectors.name: def-pattern-unclosed-group
vectors.description: An unbalanced group is INVALID_PATTERN.

vectors.name: def-pattern-nested-quantifier
vectors.description: An unbounded quantifier on a group that contains an unbounded quantifier (catastrophic backtracking) is not allowed.

vectors.name: def-pattern-empty-class
vectors.description: An empty character class differs between engines and is not allowed.

vectors.name: def-pattern-reversed-range
vectors.description: A class range whose bounds are reversed is not allowed.

vectors.name: def-pattern-dash-after-range
vectors.description: A dash that follows a completed class range is ambiguous and not allowed.

vectors.name: def-pattern-comma-brace
vectors.description: A brace that is not a valid quantifier ({n}, {n,}, {n,m}) must be escaped.

vectors.name: def-pattern-empty
vectors.description: An empty pattern is INVALID_PATTERN (omit the pattern instead).

vectors.name: def-pattern-too-long
vectors.description: A pattern longer than 200 characters is INVALID_PATTERN.

vectors.name: def-pattern-on-textarea
vectors.description: The pattern rules apply to TEXTAREA like TEXT.

vectors.name: pattern-portable-subset-matches
vectors.description: A pattern using groups, alternation, classes, counted and lazy quantifiers and anchors matches as in both engines.

vectors.name: pattern-portable-subset-mismatch
vectors.description: The same pattern rejects a value with PATTERN.

vectors.name: pattern-is-unanchored-search
vectors.description: A pattern without anchors matches anywhere in the value.

vectors.name: pattern-dot-excludes-line-terminators
vectors.description: . matches one UTF-16 code unit except \n, \r, U+2028 and U+2029 in both engines (so an astral character is two units).

vectors.name: pattern-dollar-does-not-match-before-trailing-newline
vectors.description: $ matches only at the very end of the value, never before a trailing \n.

vectors.name: pattern-class-escapes-are-ascii
vectors.description: \d and \w are ASCII-only and \b uses ASCII word characters in both engines.

vectors.name: pattern-lazy-and-counted-quantifiers
vectors.description: Counted ({n}, {n,}, {n,m}) and lazy quantifiers behave the same in both engines.

vectors.name: pattern-ignored-on-non-text-controls
vectors.description: Patterns are not checked or applied on controls outside the text family.

vectors.name: pattern-message-does-not-change-codes
vectors.description: patternMessage is display text only: the error code is still PATTERN.

vectors.name: number-exponent-notation-equals-integer
vectors.description: Numbers are compared by value as IEEE-754 doubles: 1e2 equals 100.

vectors.name: number-integers-beyond-2-53-compare-as-doubles
vectors.description: Numbers are doubles: 9007199254740993 rounds to 9007199254740992 and compares equal to it.

vectors.name: number-decimals-compare-as-doubles
vectors.description: Decimal literals are doubles: 0.10000000000000001 is the same number as 0.1.

vectors.name: number-negative-zero-equals-zero
vectors.description: -0 is the number zero: it satisfies required and equals 0.

vectors.name: number-beyond-double-range-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: A JSON number that is not a finite double (1e999) is INVALID_TYPE.

vectors.name: ref-max-safe-integer-is-valid
vectors.description: Reference ids are integers up to 2^53-1.

vectors.name: ref-above-max-safe-integer-is-invalid-type
vectors.description: 2^53 is INVALID_TYPE for a reference id.

vectors.name: ref-exponent-integral-is-valid
vectors.description: 3e0 is a JSON number with integral value and is a valid reference id.
